assistantEvent:done.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:error.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message. (stopReason error becomes a notice and a failed turn)

assistantEvent:start.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:text_end.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:text_start.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:thinking_end.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:thinking_start.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

assistantEvent:toolcall_end.note: The tool appears only when the assistant message ends.

assistantEvent:toolcall_start.note: The tool appears only when the assistant message ends, not when the call starts.

command:abort_bash.note: User shell commands are not supported.

command:abort_retry.note: A pending retry can't be cancelled on its own (only via agent.interrupt).

command:bash.note: User shell commands (the TUI's ! prefix) are not supported.

command:clear_queue.note: Sent before abort so queued steers don't restart the run.

command:cycle_model.reason: Keyboard cycling convenience; AgentConfig.model covers it.

command:cycle_thinking_level.reason: Keyboard cycling convenience; AgentConfig.effort covers it.

command:export_html.reason: Clients render the transcript from agent.history; HTML export is a pi UI feature.

command:follow_up.reason: casm keeps its own follow-up queue (agent.send whenBusy: queue).

command:get_available_thinking_levels.note: ModelInfo.efforts, derived from each model's thinking map.

command:get_commands.note: Short-lived pi in the agent cwd; skills are kind skill (name skill:x); argument hints read from prompt template frontmatter. Project prompts/skills need pi project trust (trust.json or --approve).

command:get_entries.note: History reads the active branch only; other branches are invisible.

command:get_last_assistant_text.note: casm tracks the last reply itself (lastReply).

command:get_messages.reason: Redundant: history reads the session file directly.

command:get_session_stats.note: Requested after each assistant message and compaction: totals (input includes cache read/write), cost when non-zero, contextUsage tokens and window.

command:get_state.note: Reads sessionFile; model/thinking level/queue state are dropped.

command:new_session.note: By starting a new process without --session, not with this command.

command:prompt.note: Images go as native ImageContent; "/name args" expands templates and skills and runs extension commands (disposition handled ends the turn).

command:set_follow_up_mode.reason: casm sends one steer per agent.send and queues follow-ups itself.

command:set_session_name.note: Rename isn't propagated to the native session.

command:set_steering_mode.reason: casm sends one steer per agent.send and queues follow-ups itself.

command:steer.note: whenBusy: steer (and casm sends steer for any prompt while running), with images. Slash commands go through prompt with streamingBehavior steer, since steer refuses extension commands.

command:switch_session.reason: One process per casm agent: another session is another agent (agent.create with its session).

content:image.note: User images both ways (history omits data above ~1 MB). Tool-result images still render as the text [image].

entry:context_edit.reason: Changes only future model context; pi's own UI keeps showing the original message, and so does casm.

entry:custom.note: Only entries whose data.todos is a todo list (plan-mode extension shape); other extension state is private and skipped.

entry:model_change.note: Model changes in the session are not shown or reflected in AgentConfig.

entry:thinking_level_change.note: Thinking-level changes are not shown or reflected in AgentConfig.

entry:usage.note: Counted into the token and cost totals read from the session file.

event:agent_end.reason: pi docs: agent_settled, not agent_end, marks the end of the run (retries, compaction and queued work can follow).

event:agent_start.reason: casm emits turnStarted itself when it sends the prompt.

event:auto_retry_end.note: Updates the retry notice in place: info on success, error with finalError.

event:auto_retry_start.note: Warning with attempt, delay and error; reuses the failed response's error notice id so it updates in place.

event:bash_execution_update.note: Only for the bash command, which casm doesn't support.

event:compaction_end.note: Updates the compaction notice: summary, aborted (warning) or failed (error).

event:compaction_start.note: Info notice with the reason; history shows the compaction entry.

event:entry_appended.note: Only custom entries with data.todos; other extension entries are not shown.

event:extension_error.note: Level error, with the extension file name and event.

event:message_start.reason: Stream framing: message_end carries the authoritative message.

event:message_update.note: Usage on the update is dropped; usage comes from message_end and get_session_stats.

event:queue_update.reason: casm keeps its own follow-up queue.

event:summarization_retry_finished.note: Updates the summarization retry notice to info.

event:thinking_level_changed.note: Changes made by pi/extensions aren't reflected in AgentConfig.

event:tool_execution_end.reason: Redundant: the toolResult message_end completes the tool item.

event:tool_execution_start.reason: Redundant: the toolCall block in the assistant message_end already starts the tool item.

event:tool_execution_update.note: partialResult is a cumulative snapshot (bash keeps the tail when large); only the new part is sent.

event:turn_end.reason: Per-LLM-call framing inside one casm turn.

event:turn_start.reason: Per-LLM-call framing inside one casm turn.

message:assistant.note: stopReason error adds an error notice (a warning in history when pi retried); length adds a warning; usage gives model and context tokens.

message:branchSummary.note: Via the branch_summary session entry; the message role itself is not normalized.

message:compactionSummary.note: Via the compaction session entry; the message role itself is not normalized.

message:custom.note: Only when display is true (level info).

message:system.reason: System prompt and tool loadout patches; not part of the visible conversation.

message:toolResult.note: details.todos (todo extension) also becomes a plan, id plan:<tool name>.

message:user.note: History only; live prompts are emitted by casm.

ui:editor.note: multiline text prompt; prefill becomes the placeholder.

ui:set_editor_text.note: Extensions can't prefill the client's composer.
